author: musho7-dev
subject: 5 new maps with obstacles + per-map milestone prizes
body:
Maps: Sunny Farm, Junkyard, Construction Site, Snowy Woods, Haunted Hollow,
each with its own obstacles (hay, tires, pipes, ice, tombstones...) and props.
Milestones: every map has its own distances; each next one pays more coins.
Shown as green gates in the world and green coins on the road map.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
